After the [[First Battle of Kamino|onset]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a '''medal''' was awarded to new [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadets]] upon graduation from their training at the [[clone military education complex]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], after which they became official [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. After successfully completing the [[Citadel Challenge/Legends|Citadel Challenge]], the [[Cadet/Legends|cadets]] of [[Domino Squad/Legends|Domino Squad]] all received medals, at which time [[Hevy/Legends|CT-782]], nicknamed "Hevy," entrusted his medal to the malformed [[Cloning/Legends|clone]], [[99/Legends|99]], as a symbol of their friendship.

==Behind the scenes==
Graduation medals first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] premiere, "[[Clone Cadets]]". One of the medals featured in "Clone Cadets" appeared again in the subsequent episode, "[[ARC Troopers (episode)|ARC Troopers]]."
